scripts.build: npm run build -w @school-portal/browser-sdk && npm run build -w @school-portal/web && node scripts/copy-sdk.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @school-portal/browser-sdk && npm run dev -w @school-portal/web
scripts.pack:sdk: npm run build -w @school-portal/browser-sdk && npm pack -w @school-portal/browser-sdk --pack-destination artifacts
